videos.title: 1995.08.23-Windows95-Midnight-Madness-NorwalkCT
videos.description: In August 1995, Microsoft planned the release of Windows 95 with extra hype. Resellers, including retail stores (CompUSA, Circuit City, etc) and mail order resellers (Micro Warehouse, CDW etc) all had to abide by an August 24 release date. Some resellers (encouraged by Microsoft) hyped up the release with a 'Midnight Madness' event, opening their doors at midnight, allowing for the sale of the new operating system. This was Norwalk, Connecticut.

videos.title: Buying Windows 95 on Launch Day
videos.description:
Footage from the launch day of Window 95. 

Very short video of people purchasing the product on August 24, 1995 at Egghead Software and a CompUSA store.

Also, a short interview with a CompUSA store employee.
